card.name: Start of conivaptan in CYP3A4 inhibitor lists
card.fires_on: The first piece "con" of the drug name conivaptan, when it appears in lists of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors after names like clarithromycin or ketoconazole. Also fires weakly on the "F" starting a brand name like FERABRIGHT.

modes.label: conivaptan in inhibitor list
modes.description: The start of conivaptan in a comma-separated list of strong enzyme inhibitor drugs.
modes.example: including, but not limited to, ritonavir, clarithromycin,<< con>>ivaptan, indinavir

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: The first letter of an all-caps brand name after an instruction to administer it.
modes.example: Only administer<< F>>ERABRIGHT as an intravenous infusion

card.writes: It pushes toward word pieces like "pen" and "CM" and away from pieces like "IB", so it does not clearly help finish conivaptan.
card.plain: It lights up on the start of the drug name conivaptan when it is listed among strong CYP3A4 inhibitors.
